name: VayaPin Connector
author: vayapin

sections.description:
Stop Losing Sales at Checkout. Stop Losing Money on Failed Deliveries.

41% of customers abandon their cart when address entry is difficult. 39% of deliveries fail due to inaccurate addresses. VayaPin Checkout Autofill solves both problems with a single, free integration.

WooCommerce: requires 3.0 or higher; tested through 9.x. WordPress: 6.0+, tested up to 6.7.

What VayaPin Is

VayaPin is a GPS-precision digital address system — a unique, human-readable code (like MARIA86) that maps to an exact physical location, including GPS coordinates, entrance photos, and custom delivery instructions. Your customer enters MARIA86 at checkout. Every field autofills instantly. Checkout complete in seconds.

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin — Add the VayaPin input field to your WooCommerce checkout. Works with standard checkout and WooCommerce Blocks. Configure in under 5 minutes.
  2. Customer checks out — Has a VayaPin? Enters MARIA86 → entire form autofills → order complete in seconds. No VayaPin? Completes checkout normally, checks “Create my VayaPin” → receives their code by email → uses it on every future VayaPin-enabled store.
  3. Perfect delivery — Every order includes GPS coordinates, driver instructions, and entrance photos. Generate a QR delivery label to share with your shipping partner.
  4. Your store grows — Customers who create a VayaPin through your checkout tag your store as a “Favourite Pin” — keeping your brand top-of-mind for their next order.

Why Merchants Choose VayaPin

  • 41% Less Cart Abandonment — 56% of customers are frustrated filling in address forms. VayaPin’s one-tap autofill eliminates this friction. Works perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
  • GPS-Precise Deliveries — VayaPin provides exact GPS coordinates and entrance photos with every order — not just a street address. Drivers navigate to the exact delivery spot. Each failed delivery costs $17–$30 to reship. VayaPin prevents these losses.
  • Always-Current Customer Data — When customers update their VayaPin address, your order data automatically reflects the change. No more bounced emails, disconnected numbers, or delivering to old addresses.
  • Better Reviews, Fewer Refunds — 85% of customers won’t return after a poor delivery experience. Perfect deliveries mean fewer support calls, fewer refunds, and more 5-star reviews.

Plugin Features

  • VayaPin autofill field at checkout — configurable label, placeholder, and position
  • Instant API lookup — fills name, address, phone, email, city, zip, country, and GPS coordinates in under one second
  • Customer opt-in checkbox — “Create my VayaPin for faster checkout everywhere” — grows your loyal customer base automatically
  • GPS coordinate capture on every VayaPin order — stored in WooCommerce order meta
  • Delivery instructions and entrance photos captured with each order
  • QR delivery label generation — print or share with your shipping partner
  • VayaPin delivery metabox in the WooCommerce order screen
  • Analytics dashboard — autofill conversions, autofill rate, new VayaPins, revenue saved
  • Compatible with classic checkout and WooCommerce Blocks checkout
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Hooks and filters for developer customisation
  • GDPR compliant — customers explicitly consent before data is shared
  • Responsive — mobile, tablet, and desktop

Pricing

Plugin download is free. API token from vayapin.com/developers. Starter: 50 conversions/month, free, no credit card required. Paid tiers (Business, Professional, Scale, Enterprise) — see vayapin.com/pricing. All paid plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee.

External services

This plugin uses the VayaPin API during checkout and admin flows.

  • Service: VayaPin API
  • Endpoint (example): https://cs.vayapin.com
  • Terms: VayaPin Terms of Use
  • Privacy: VayaPin Privacy Policy

Only send data required for API auth and lookups you enable. Use a valid token; disclose flows in your privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload vayapin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate under Plugins.
  3. Install WooCommerce (3.0+).
  4. Open WooCommerce → VayaPin, set API key and environment, save.
  5. Configure checkout copy, styling, webhooks, and delivery options.

API token: vayapin.com/developers
sections.faq:
Is the free plan completely free — no credit card required?

Yes. The Starter plan includes 50 conversions per month at no cost, with no credit card required. All plugin features are available on the free plan. Upgrade only when you’re ready to scale.

Will this slow down my store?

No. VayaPin loads asynchronously and has no measurable impact on Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, or INP). The JavaScript payload is minimal and is only loaded on checkout pages where it is needed.

What happens when a customer doesn’t have a VayaPin?

They complete checkout normally with their regular address. We show a simple checkbox: “Create my VayaPin with this information for faster checkout everywhere.” If they opt in, they receive their permanent digital address code by email — ready to use on any future VayaPin-enabled store.

Does this work with my theme and checkout setup?

Yes. VayaPin is compatible with all major WooCommerce themes and works with both the classic checkout and WooCommerce Blocks checkout. We provide hooks and filters for developer customisation. If you use a heavily modified checkout, our support team will assist with any compatibility issues.

Is customer data secure and GDPR compliant?

Yes. All data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Customers explicitly authorise sharing their VayaPin data at checkout — full consent flow included. VayaPin is fully GDPR compliant. Your store receives only delivery-relevant information.

What if a customer moves or changes their contact details?

When customers update their VayaPin, your store automatically receives their current details on their next order. No more bounced emails, disconnected numbers, or delivering to old addresses.

Do my customers need the VayaPin Chrome extension?

No. The WooCommerce plugin works entirely independently of the browser extension. Customers enter their VayaPin code directly into the checkout field — no browser extension is required. The Chrome extension is a separate VayaPin product for autofilling forms on any website.

What data does my store receive per order?

Full name, address, phone, email, city, postcode, country, GPS coordinates (latitude and longitude), entrance type, and any custom delivery instructions the customer has added to their VayaPin profile.

What happens if I exceed my monthly conversion limit?

Your plugin continues processing orders without interruption. You receive email alerts at 80% and 100% of your monthly limit. Overages are billed at a per-conversion rate — see vayapin.com/pricing for current rates.

Can I use this on multiple WooCommerce sites?

Yes. Each site requires its own API token, but you can manage multiple sites from a single VayaPin developer account. Plans and conversion limits apply per token.

What payment gateways does VayaPin work with?

All of them. VayaPin only handles address autofill — it has no involvement in payment processing and is fully compatible with all WooCommerce payment gateways, including Stripe, PayPal, Square, and WooPayments.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes. All paid SaaS subscription plans include a 30-day money-back guarantee. Contact support@vayapin.com within 30 days of your first paid charge for a full refund. The WordPress plugin itself is free — the guarantee applies to the paid SaaS subscription only.

Where is documentation and support?

  • docs.vayapin.com
  • support.vayapin.com
  • vayapin.com/feature-requests
